purpose: For a new general tilt grain boundary in FCC Ni, resolve the user's geometry: tilt-axis family <110>, ordered plane families {110} || {111}. Determine all constraint-compatible concrete grain-local plane members and paired concrete grain-local tilt directions using analyze_tilt_geometry with axis_is_family=true and plane1_is_family=true, plane2_is_family=true. Identify whether there is one physical choice up to proper-cubic/unoriented equivalence or multiple physically distinct choices. Compare planar atomic densities of the two resolved actual FCC planes to assign the higher-density selected plane side to spatial bottom (retain pair order if equal), without relabeling GB1/GB2. Report actual top and bottom planes, their corresponding local tilt directions, and shared-frame geometry/misorientation. Then perform reverse near-CSL lookup for the original resolved ordered general-boundary geometry: scan every FCC-basis-valid Sigma rotation about the compatible axis within the applicable angle tolerance, compare bounded exact ordered plane pairs under fixed-axis symmetry, include angle and both plane deviations, snapped angle, delta angle, Sigma and rotation_m/rotation_n branch, and select the closest reference if any. Treat any nonzero-deviation Sigma only as a descriptive near-CSL reference and explicitly prohibit replacing the original planes/orientations/periods downstream. This result will be handed to LAMMPS for construction and minimization of the original general boundary.
